The 2023 Chinese College Programming Contest (Qinhuangdao) Official

A. Make SYSU Great Again I
(int, int)[] construct_grid(int N, int K);
- Construct a N-by-N grid, such that the following conditions hold.
- Each row and column has at least two number.
- Greatest common divisor of Row i equals that of Column i.

B. Yet Another Subsequence Problem
int count_below(int A, int B);
- Count the number of subsequence of the string by the below-diagonal walk in A-by-B grid.

C. Palindrome
(int, int)[] minimum_costs(int N, string S, int M, range[] A);
- Operation: delete a substring with the cost of the length.
- Find and count ways of minimum cost to make the substrings palindrome, applying at most one operation.

D. Yet Another Coffee
int[] minimum_price(int N, int[] A, int M, int[] R, int[] W);
- The price of coffee at day i is A[i].
- Coupons can be used on or after day R[j] and reduce the cost by W[j].
- Find the minimum money spent if buy coffee on K days for all K.

E. Coloring Tape
int count_ways(int N, int M, int R, int[] C, int[] X, int[] Y, int[] D);
- Given a grid of N rows and M columns, with N brushes of different colours at (i, 0).
- Given R restrictions of the form A[C[i]][X[i]] ^ A[C[i]][Y[i]] = D[i].
- Count the number of ways of painting.

F. Mystery of Prime
int sum_primes(int N, int[] A);
- Given an array A of length N.
- Minimise the number of changed elements to make all adjacent elements sum to prime.

G. Path
int maximum_change(int N, int M, int[] A, int[] B);
- Given a N-by-M grid with C[x][y] = A[x] + B[y].
- Maximise path from (1, 1) to (N, M) that maximise total absolute difference.

H. Quake and Rebuild
void init(int N, int[] P);
- Given a rooted tree of N nodes.
void quake(int L, int R, int D);
- Set P[i] := max(0, P[i] - D) for all i in [L, R].
int rebuild(int K, int[] B);
- Count the number of nodes on the virtual tree of B.

I. Phony
void init(int N, int[] A, int K);
- Given an array of length N and a constant K.
void decrease(int T);
- Decrease the maximum element in A for K times.
int kth_max(int K);
- Returns the kth maximum of A.

J. Keyi Likes Reading
int minimum_days(int M, int W, int[] C);
- Returns minimum number of bags of size W to contains all C[i].

K. Make SYSU Great Again II
int construct_grid(int N);
- Returns a grid that satisfy the following conditions.
- Each number appears at most five times.
- Each adjacent cells AND together is zero.

L. Yet Another Maximize Permutation Subarrays
(int, int) best_swap(int N, int[] A);
- Swap two elements in A that maximise the number of subarray permutations.

M. Inverted
int[] count_spanning_trees(int N, edge[] E, int[] B);
- Given a tree of N nodes and operate on nodes N - 1 times.
- To operate on node x, create node x + N and for each edge (x, y), connect (x + N, y) or (x + N, y + N).
